result.title: Video2Asset: Online Construction of Persistent 3D Street-Scene Assets
result.summary: Online 3D street-scene asset construction turns multi-view video into a continually updated scene of independently editable objects. The central challenge is to accumulate partial, intermittent observations under motion and occlusion without fragmenting identities or mixing evidence across objects. To address this challenge, we propose Video2Asset, an online framework for constructing persistent 3D assets from multi-view video. Using occupancy as an intermediate representation, we construct identity-aware observations with Historical Carrier Guidance for instance decoding and an identity encoder fusing instance-aligned 3D features with multi-view appearance. Accumulated-Evidence Association compares current observations with identity, geometric, and appearance evidence accumulated within asset records to determine identity inheritance and update world-coordinate states. We instantiate meshes from an asset library using these states and combine them with an occupancy-derived static background to support scene visualization, mesh replacement, object deletion, and trajectory editing. Experiments on several datasets demonstrate improvements in temporal identity consistency and asset quality across multiple occupancy models, including a 15.4% reduction in asset fragmentation on nuScenes with SGE.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Video2Asset，以 occupancy 为中间表示，从多视角视频在线构建可独立编辑、身份持久的 3D 街景资产，并用累积证据关联与身份编码维持跨帧身份一致和世界坐标状态更新。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在资产记录中累积身份、几何与外观证据以决定继承并更新状态」的机制，可能为 LVR 中跨推理步持续维护视觉证据、避免不同对象证据混淆提供可核查的类比，但该工作本身属 3D 场景重建，未涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态生成。
